name: Past Perfect
summaryPt: Ação que aconteceu antes de outra ação no passado.

meaningUses.pt: Ação que ocorreu antes de outra no passado
meaningUses.en: The meeting had started before I arrived.
meaningUses.enPt: A reunião já tinha começado antes de eu chegar.

meaningUses.pt: Explicar o que já tinha acontecido
meaningUses.en: I was tired because I had worked all day.
meaningUses.enPt: Eu estava cansado porque tinha trabalhado o dia todo.

formation.pattern: I had worked — she had gone

examples.en: I had finished before you came.
examples.pt: Eu tinha terminado antes de você chegar.
Eu não tinha visto isso antes.

examples.en: Had you seen the movie before?
examples.pt: Você já tinha visto o filme antes?

formation.pt: Yes, + pronome + had. No, + pronome + hadn't.
formation.pattern: Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't.

examples.en: A: Had you eaten? B: No, I hadn't.
examples.pt: A: Você tinha comido? B: Não.

subjectAgreement.pt: A mesma forma (had) para todas as pessoas.
subjectAgreement.example: I had gone. She had gone. They had gone.

pronunciation.pt: had é pronunciado /hæd/, mas na fala rápida pode virar /əd/ ou /d/.

commonErrors.pt: Usar past simple onde o past perfect marca 'antes de'
commonErrors.wrong: The meeting started before I arrived, but I didn't know.
commonErrors.right: The meeting had started before I arrived.
commonErrors.explanation: A reunião começou ANTES de eu chegar → past perfect.

contrast.pt: Past simple = ação no passado. Past perfect = ação que já tinha ocorrido antes de outra.
contrast.en: I arrived at 9. The meeting had started at 8:30.
contrast.enPt: Cheguei às 9. A reunião tinha começado às 8h30.

examples.en: The meeting had started before I arrived.
examples.pt: A reunião já tinha começado antes de eu chegar.

examples.en: I was tired because I had worked all day.
examples.pt: Eu estava cansado porque tinha trabalhado o dia todo.

examples.en: She had left before we got there.
examples.pt: Ela tinha saído antes de chegarmos lá.
Eu não tinha visto isso antes.

examples.en: Had you finished your homework before dinner?
examples.pt: Você tinha terminado a lição antes do jantar?

guidedPractice.prompt: The meeting ___ started before I arrived.
guidedPractice.full: The meeting had started before I arrived.
guidedPractice.pt: A reunião já tinha começado antes de eu chegar.
guidedPractice.explanation: Ação antes de outra no passado → had + particípio.

guidedPractice.full: I had finished before you came.
guidedPractice.pt: Eu tinha terminado antes de você chegar.

guidedPractice.prompt: She had ___ before we got there.
guidedPractice.full: She had left before we got there.
guidedPractice.pt: Ela tinha saído antes de chegarmos lá.

guidedPractice.prompt: I was tired because I ___ worked all day.
guidedPractice.full: I was tired because I had worked all day.
guidedPractice.pt: Eu estava cansado porque tinha trabalhado o dia todo.
Eu não tinha visto isso antes.

guidedPractice.full: Had you eaten before the party?
guidedPractice.pt: Você tinha comido antes da festa?

guidedPractice.prompt: A: Had you finished? B: Yes, I ___.
guidedPractice.full: A: Had you finished? B: Yes, I had.
guidedPractice.pt: A: Você tinha terminado? B: Sim.

guidedPractice.prompt: She had ___ (write) the report before the meeting.
guidedPractice.full: She had written the report before the meeting.
guidedPractice.pt: Ela tinha escrito o relatório antes da reunião.

reviewQuiz.prompt: The train ___ left before we arrived.
reviewQuiz.full: The train had left before we arrived.
reviewQuiz.pt: O trem tinha saído antes de chegarmos.

reviewQuiz.full: She had finished before we called.
reviewQuiz.pt: Ela tinha terminado antes de ligarmos.

reviewQuiz.prompt: I had ___ my keys before leaving.
reviewQuiz.full: I had found my keys before leaving.
reviewQuiz.pt: Eu tinha achado minhas chaves antes de sair.

reviewQuiz.prompt: She was sad because she ___ lost her phone.
reviewQuiz.full: She was sad because she had lost her phone.
reviewQuiz.pt: Ela estava triste porque tinha perdido o celular.

reviewQuiz.full: They hadn't eaten before the party.
reviewQuiz.pt: Eles não tinham comido antes da festa.

reviewQuiz.full: Had she left before you arrived?
reviewQuiz.pt: Ela tinha saído antes de você chegar?

reviewQuiz.prompt: A: Had she called? B: No, she ___.
reviewQuiz.full: A: Had she called? B: No, she hadn't.
reviewQuiz.pt: A: Ela tinha ligado? B: Não.
reviewQuiz.explanation: Resposta curta negativa: No, she hadn't.

reviewQuiz.prompt: They had ___ (go) home before the storm.
reviewQuiz.full: They had gone home before the storm.
reviewQuiz.pt: Eles tinham ido para casa antes da tempestade.

reviewQuiz.prompt: The movie ___ already started when we sat down.
reviewQuiz.full: The movie had already started when we sat down.
reviewQuiz.pt: O filme já tinha começado quando sentamos.

reviewQuiz.prompt: By the time I arrived, they ___ (leave).
reviewQuiz.full: By the time I arrived, they had left.
reviewQuiz.pt: Quando cheguei, eles já tinham saído.
reviewQuiz.explanation: By the time + ação anterior → had + particípio.
